text: For I look upon it as highly presuming to pretend to guess, before a case is heard, what time it will require, and to set limits to an affair before one is acquainted with its extent; especially as the first and most sacred duty of a judge is patience, which constitutes an important part of justice.
author: Pliny the Younger
translation: William Melmoth, rev. F. C. T. Bosanquet
